messages:
sophia: Postmortem summary and follow-ups from today's incident — root cause was a cache invalidation change that exposed a cold-path latency regression. Proposed actions and owners below.

sophia: 1) Prompt/regression suite focused on cached vs cold paths (owner: @leila) — extract incident prompts + adversarial cases. due: EOD Fri.

sophia: 2) Load/burst testing profile to validate tail latencies under sudden traffic (owner: @ryan). add k6 profile + nightly long run. due: next Tue.

sophia: 3) Chaos drill for cache eviction + multi-region failover (owner: @omar). schedule canary-mode first, then full drill. due: 2 weeks.

sophia: 4) CI eval gating: add a blocking check for model/regression that increases latency >10% on representative prompt set (owner: @sophia).

sophia: I'll create tracker tickets for each action.

leila: ack. I'll start by curating ~50 prompts from the incident logs, then synthesize 10 adversarial variants (truncation, long context, repeated tokens). Need guidance mapping prompt->expected token cost vs latency.

ryan: I'll own the load tests. Plan: add a "burst" k6 profile that ramps to peak QPS seen during the incident and measures P50/P95/P99 token latencies. Run on PRs for infra changes, long-run nightly. Drafting ENG-2910 now.

omar: happy to run the chaos drill. can we make it non-disruptive for customer-facing stacks? propose a canary-only mode with mirrored traffic + failover rehearsal in staging first. also will update the runbook with rollback steps.

devbot: Created tickets ENG-2910 (load tests), ENG-2911 (prompt regression suite), ENG-2912 (chaos drill).

sophia: tagging @leila @ryan @omar — let's do a 15m sync after standup to align scope. Requirement: any regression suite must include at least 3 representative prompt templates and 1 adversarial case. Example quick run command for the harness:```./eval_harness run --suite incident_regression --model redwood-v1 --profile burst```

leila: q: where do we keep canonical prompt sets? repo suggestion: github.com/redwood/inference-evals/prompt-sets. prefer adding subfolders by incident id.

ryan: agree on repo. Also add metric assertions to the test harness: P50, P95, P99 token latency and CPU 99th. We'll encode thresholds in ENG-2910.

omar: can we align chaos drills with on-call rotation? quarterly cadence sounds right.

sophia: yes — quarterly drills tied to on-call. first drill target date: 2026-07-08. I'll send calendar invite and owner tags. deliverables per action: PR(s) adding suites, CI runs with passing thresholds, updated runbook, drill report.

leila: I'll add a checklist to the PR template referencing the incident notes: https://go/redwood/postmortems/2026-06-cache-eviction

ryan: note — if CI gating is blocking, we need an exemption flow for experimental models. propose a feature-flagged exemption `ci_latency_blocking` + on-call approval flow.

omar: one more ask — capture a sample KV cache snapshot and dev seeds so the team can reproduce the cold path locally.

sophia: Action items summary (copying into the tracker): - ENG-2911 prompt regression (leila) due EOD Fri - ENG-2910 load tests + thresholds (ryan) due Tue - ENG-2912 chaos drill (omar) due in 2 weeks - CI gating proposal (sophia) doc by EOD. If anything missing, comment here. :thumbsup:

devbot: Reminder: retrospective review meeting scheduled 2026-07-01 10:00.

leila: :thumbsup: filing PR today with initial prompt set and README for how to run.

ryan: will post ENG-2910 k6 profile and sample results to the ticket when ready.

omar: will draft the canary drill plan and runbook changes by end of week.
